C-9.Name: Fix title-bar overflow: path/filename collide with nav cluster and word count at narrow widths
C-9.Summary: User report: "при сильном уменьшении путь и имя не вмещаются в тайтлбар и некрасиво всё наезжает одно на другое". Reproduced live via CUA at 300px window width: the breadcrumb renders unclipped from the nav cluster to the word-count widget, jamming into both. Root cause: the GH#339 clip rule `div.title > span` (display:block + direction:rtl + overflow:hidden) DOES match its scoped direct-child span, but its rtl-clip never produced a reliable left-side-only clip under the inherited centered text layout, and `.title { padding: 0 142px }` was sized for the pre-v1.1.0 left column while the v1.1.0 titlebar-nav cluster occupies ~240px on macOS starting at left:78px. Fix: absolutely position `.title` between explicit left/right clearances, and clip inside a flex breadcrumb whose path part shrinks (clipping oldest segments from the left, flex-end packing) while the filename never shrinks. Below the app's 600px window minimum the constrained title box collapses toward zero width — the breadcrumb degrades to hidden, never overlapping its neighbors.

Problem.Description: Breadcrumb path + filename overlap the nav buttons and the right-side word count at narrow window widths.
Problem.RootCause: The GH#339 rtl-clip on the direct-child span does not reliably clip the path side under the inherited centered layout, and the fixed paddings are smaller than the v1.1.0 nav cluster extent.
Problem.Evidence: CUA 2026-09-16, /tmp/mark-qa-shots/t2-crop.png (300px): "private › tmp › mark-qa-c6 › rich.md" starts at the theme-toggle icon and ends under "292 words". titleBar/index.vue CSS `.title { padding: 0 142px }` vs `.titlebar-nav--osx { left: 78px }` + 5×28px buttons + divider ≈ 240px.

Goals.R-1: Template: wrap the breadcrumb content in a `.title-breadcrumb` flex container with a `.title-path` part (path spans + arrows) and the existing `.filename` + `.save-dot` as non-shrinking tail items.
Goals.R-2: CSS: `.title` becomes an absolutely positioned box with real left/right clearances (macOS: left 250px past the nav cluster; other platforms left 180px; right 150px past the right toolbar) so its width is genuinely constrained; `.title-breadcrumb` centers when it fits; `.title-path` is `flex: 0 1 auto; overflow: hidden; justify-content: flex-end` so overflow clips the OLDEST path segments on the left while the nearest folder + filename stay visible; `.filename { flex-shrink: 0 }`.
Goals.R-3: Remove the unreliable GH#339 `div.title > span` rtl-clip rule; keep the no-Mark fallback span unaffected.
Goals.R-4: Tests: titleBar component test pins the new structure (.title-breadcrumb present, path segments inside .title-path, filename outside it) and a source-pin test asserts the clearance rule and the removed dead selector.

Constraints.Constraint: No behavior change at comfortable widths: full path stays visible when it fits.
Keep the drag-region attributes and context-menu/rename handlers untouched.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Responsive hiding of nav buttons or word count; middle-ellipsis rendering.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Nothing overlaps at any width: at the app's 600px window minimum the nearest folder + filename stay fully visible with the path clipped from the left; below-minimum widths (reachable only programmatically) collapse the title box toward zero instead of rendering over the nav cluster or word count.
At wide widths the full breadcrumb renders centered exactly as before.

C-9.VerificationIntent: Component/source-pin tests; CUA live check at 600px (app minimum) and 1200px with a 3-segment path; below-minimum width must degrade to a collapsed title, never overlap.
